16.title: Total Merck Applications in Dynatrace
16.query:
load "/lookups/cmdb_businessapp"
| fieldsAdd cmdb_ci_key, appname = name
| lookup [load "/lookups/cmdb_server"], sourceField:cmdb_ci_key, lookupField:busapp_cmdb_ci_key, fields:{cmdbhostname = name, server_fqdn = fully_qualified_domain_name}
| filter isNotNull(name)
| lookup [
fetch dt.entity.host
| fields id, entity.name,  monitoringMode, paasVendorType, isMonitoringCandidate, awsNameTag
| fieldsAdd monitoringMode = if(isNotNull(paasVendorType), "APP_ONLY", else:if(isMonitoringCandidate == true, "CANDIDATE", else:monitoringMode)),
            provider = if(isNotNull(awsNameTag), "aws", else: "merck")
| fieldsRemove paasVendorType, awsNameTag, isMonitoringCandidate
| parse entity.name, """LD:hostname ('.' LD:domain)? EOS"""
| limit 20000], sourceField:cmdbhostname, lookupField:hostname, fields:{id, hostname, monitoringMode}
| filter isNotNull(hostname)
| summarize `Total Applications` = count()

17.title: CMDB Apps By Tier

18.title: Application Observability Overview
18.query:
fetch dt.entity.host
| fields id, entity.name,  monitoringMode, paasVendorType, isMonitoringCandidate, awsNameTag
| fieldsAdd monitoringMode = if(isNotNull(paasVendorType), "APP_ONLY", else:if(isMonitoringCandidate == true, "CANDIDATE", else:monitoringMode)),
            provider = if(isNotNull(awsNameTag), "aws", else: "merck")
| fieldsRemove paasVendorType, awsNameTag, isMonitoringCandidate
| parse entity.name, """LD:hostname ('.' LD:domain)? EOS"""
| limit 20000
| lookup [load "/lookups/cmdb_server"], sourceField:hostname, lookupField:name, fields:{busapp_key = busapp_cmdb_ci_key, server_location = location}
| filter isNotNull(busapp_key)
| lookup [load "/lookups/cmdb_businessapp"], sourceField:busapp_key, lookupField:cmdb_ci_key, fields:{app_name = name, app_short_name = short_name, app_owner = owned_by, app_tier = business_criticality, app_bu = dv_business_unit, app_status = dv_operational_status}
| filter isNotNull(app_name)
| lookup [fetch logs | summarize logCount = count(), by:{log_host = dt.entity.host}], sourceField:id, lookupField:log_host, fields:{logCount}
| fieldsAdd app_short_name_lower = lower(app_short_name)
| lookup [
    fetch dt.davis.problems
    | filter not(dt.davis.is_duplicate) AND event.status == "ACTIVE"
    | expand affected_entity_id = affected_entity_ids
    | filter matchesPhrase(affected_entity_id, "HOST-")
    | lookup [
        fetch dt.entity.host
        | fields id, tags
        | expand tag = tags
        | parse tag, """'HGApp:' LD:appShortName EOS"""
        | filter isNotNull(appShortName)
        | fieldsAdd appShortName = lower(appShortName)
        | fields id, appShortName
      ], sourceField:affected_entity_id, lookupField:id, fields:{appShortName}
    | filter isNotNull(appShortName)
    | summarize activeProblems = countDistinct(display_id), by:{appShortName}
  ], sourceField:app_short_name_lower, lookupField:appShortName, fields:{activeProblems}
| fieldsRemove app_short_name_lower
| lookup [load "/lookups/cmdb_server" | summarize cmdbServerCount = count(), by:{busapp_cmdb_ci_key}], sourceField:busapp_key, lookupField:busapp_cmdb_ci_key, fields:{cmdbServerCount}
| summarize
    owner = takeFirst(app_owner),
    AppShortName = takeFirst(app_short_name),
    `Business Unit` = takeFirst(app_bu),
    tier = takeFirst(app_tier),
    location = takeFirst(server_location),
    fullStackCount = countIf(monitoringMode == "FULL_STACK"),
    infraCount = countIf(monitoringMode == "INFRASTRUCTURE"),
    discoveryCount = countIf(monitoringMode == "DISCOVERY"),
    logHostCount = countIf(isNotNull(logCount) AND logCount > 0),
    `Active Problems` = coalesce(takeFirst(activeProblems), 0),
    Status = takeFirst(app_status),
    Footprint = count(),
    `CMDB Servers` = takeFirst(cmdbServerCount),
    by:{`Merck Application` = app_name}
| fieldsAdd
    monitoringMode = if(fullStackCount > 0, "Full Stack", else: if(discoveryCount > 0, "Discovery", else: "Infrastructure")),
    Traces = if(fullStackCount > 0, "\u2705", else: "\u274c"),
    Metrics = if(fullStackCount > 0 OR infraCount > 0, "\u2705", else: "\u274c"),
    Logs = if(logHostCount > 0, "\u2705", else: "\u274c"),
    RUM = if(fullStackCount > 0, "\u2705", else: "\u274c")
| fieldsRemove fullStackCount, infraCount, discoveryCount, logHostCount
| fields `Merck Application`, `Business Unit`, AppShortName, owner, tier, location, monitoringMode, Traces, Metrics, Logs, RUM, `Active Problems`, Footprint, `CMDB Servers`, Status
| filter in(`Merck Application`, array($MerckApplicationName))
| filter in(`Business Unit`, array($BusinessUnit))
| filter in(tier, array($Tier))
| filter in(location, array($Location))
| filter in(monitoringMode, array($MonitoringMode))
| filter in(Status, array($Status))
| sort `Merck Application` asc

19.title: Servers Monitored by Dynatrace
19.query:
fetch dt.entity.host
| fieldsAdd host_name = entity.name
| fields id, entity.name,  monitoringMode, paasVendorType, isMonitoringCandidate, awsNameTag
| fieldsAdd monitoringMode = if(isNotNull(paasVendorType), "APP_ONLY", else:if(isMonitoringCandidate == true, "CANDIDATE", else:monitoringMode))
| parse entity.name, """LD:hostname ('.' LD:domain)? EOS"""
| lookup [ load "/lookups/cmdb_server"], sourcefield:hostname, lookupfield:name, fields:{server_fqdn = fully_qualified_domain_name, cmdb_ci_key}
| fieldsRemove paasVendorType, awsNameTag, isMonitoringCandidate
| fieldsAdd isInCMDB = if(isNull(cmdb_ci_key), "NOT FOUND IN CMDB", else:"FOUND IN CMDB")
| filterOut isInCMDB == "NOT FOUND IN CMDB" 
| filterOut monitoringMode == "CANDIDATE"
| limit 20000
| summarize `Monitored Servers` = count()
